reviewed_scope: Only the proposed 0xA220 payload predicate, omitted PadVal/duplicate/update semantics, relevant section citations, and structural-skipping interpretation. Other field-family entries were not independently audited.

findings.assessment: Section 4.6.10 lists TSize as Sig+PadVal+Padding, with two Short fields and NUL padding. The proposed L>=4, verification signature 0xA028 and all-zero remaining L-4 bytes are consistent with that listed shape. Section 4.3.3 supplies little endian; wire signature 28 a0 follows. No positive padding minimum is stated, so L=4 is a permissible zero-tail shape inference, not proof of producer history.

findings.claim: Unbound initial-padding and wider profile semantics
findings.assessment: Section 4.6.10 does not specify PadVal==L-4, any relationship to current remaining padding, positive/nonzero constraints, duplicate handling, local/central correspondence, placement or update history. The report correctly withholds these and full OPC conformance.

Sections 4.5.1 and 4.6.2 support bounded ID/length/data records and advancing over uninteresting blocks. They do not certify that every unknown block is semantically irrelevant to extraction or application identity. Section 4.4.28 concerns finding the next file/header; it does not strengthen this into arbitrary-extension semantic safety.

Section 4.6.3 expressly warns that two programs may use the same ID and recommends checking a unique body signature. Wrong signature therefore fails the proposed identification, rather than proving entire ZIP corruption. The third-party preamble disclaims guaranteed accuracy. Neither ID+signature nor format agreement authenticates a producer.

nonblocking_citation_suggestion.text: This section explicitly says all fields are unsigned unless otherwise noted; it can be cited for the report's unsigned PadVal reading. The claim itself is supported.
